core.title: Design Hardware 316R Door Closer with Replacement Plate

text.description_html:
316R Design Hardware Aluminum Door Closer

Design Hardware offers you solutions proven to fit every application from the heaviest use to the most prestigious and even the aesthetically pleasing. You will find their high quality products in residential and commercial projects around the world.

316R Design Hardware Specs:

  • Meets ANSI A156.4 Grade 1 Standards.
  • UL Listed, Non Handed
  • Adjustable Spring Power 1 to 6 for ADA compliance.
  • Includes Patented Mounting Plate that can replace a wide variety of door closers without drilling new holes in the door.
  • Heavy Duty Aluminum Closer Body
  • Back Check Control standard.
  • Latch Speed & Sweep Controls.
  • Parallel Arm Bracket Included.
  • Through Bolts 1 3/4".
  • Wood and Machine screw fasteners.
  • Molded Cover included.

Installation Guide: Click here to download. (PDF).
